name: Dog Lake
blurb: Contour-derived bathymetry from 1972.0/1978.0/1981.0 MNRF transect surveys (years from the LIO bathymetry index; contour feature dates are null in LIO). No depth soundings exist for this lake - depths are interpolated between the survey contours and capped at 106.1 m; confidence is strictly distance-to-contour (83.4% of water cells at >=0.4). Cool-regime lake; cisco, walleye, smallmouth bass in the ARA community. Secchi 2.5 m (ARA).
